correctness.rationale: The exact 96-facet complex reconstructs f=(15,105,230,240,96). Unimodular integral reduction of the 230 facial relations in the rank-91 graph-cycle lattice gives diag(1^88,0,0,0), proving H1=Z^3 and supplying exact quotient coordinates. Exhaustion of all 225 nonfacial triangles gives no zero class, gcd one for every coordinate vector, and exactly seven sign-classes with multiplicities 46,46,46,18,18,18,33. The full facet set and the explicit basis carriers verify the order-three cyclic action.

value.rationale: The fifteen-vertex complex is a classical vertex-minimal tight four-manifold with rank-three first homology, making its absolute first simple-cycle layer a natural combinatorial systolic invariant. The complete layer is unexpectedly rigid: 225 carriers collapse to seven primitive sign-directions, exactly the nonzero binary subset sums of a symmetry-adapted basis, with the order-three automorphism explaining the 46^3 and 18^3 multiplicity blocks. This structure is not encoded by the known face vector, Betti number, or generic tightness.
